author: /root read-only research
existingFacts: Dashboard Node HTTP server binds127.0.0.1, accepts loopback Host, GET-only routes, no-store/nosniff/no-referrer/CSP self and frame-ancestors none.

Dashboard navigation has a static61228 product link. app.js/architecture.js matched no innerHTML/eval/document.write sinks in targeted read; app.js stores theme only. This is not an exhaustive XSS security audit.

Personal preview creates a0700 outside-source installation directory and0600 config.json with ownerToken. Center launcher injects that field as FLOW_TOKEN; it is distinct from runner/provider credentials.
loadPreviewConfiguration imports PG and service/publishing modules; new dashboard read capability should not import the entire launcher or add service control.
proposedInterface: An explicit, default-off local installation option binds one canonical installation directory, expected nonsecret installation identity and correct loopback product origin. No browser-supplied file/path/URL, no default remote/enterprise exposure.
Public connection metadata may expose enabled/productURL/center-relative-path/help only. Keep it separate from status aggregation and architecture. Never serialize raw install config.

One dedicated on-demand credential POST accepts only exact allowed Host/listening authority and loopback peer, exact same Origin, same-origin fetch metadata and a deliberate custom header. Reject missing/null/mismatched Origin, cross-site/same-site other-port, navigation, non-POST and OPTIONS; emit no permissive CORS. Do not trust Forwarded headers.

Provider reads only configured config.json using bounded file size, owner/mode/type/symlink and installation identity checks. Prefer descriptor-based open with no-follow and validation to avoid checking one inode then reading another. Project only the owner credential; sanitize errors without configuration, paths or credential bytes.

Maintain no-store on success/failure, no-referrer/nosniff/frame protection, no-cache client fetch; no token in initialHTML,staticassets,GET snapshot,logs,URL,plan/evidence,localStorage/sessionStorage.

UI independent local-access module: masked initially without hidden token in DOM; show/copy is explicit; pending requests use generation/abort so a late response cannot reveal after close/hide; clear DOM/memory on hide/dialog-close/visibility-away. No automatic clipboard clearing or extra browser credential platform.

Clipboard success only after writeText resolves. On denied/unsupported operation show an actionable failure and allow explicit reveal/manual copy; preserve keyboard focus/escape/return and theme/narrow layout. Avoid promising clipboard support after an asynchronous fetch without testing user-activation behavior.
testAcceptance: Bounded synthetic config/HTTP tests for default-off, wrong Host/origin/peer, null/missing Origin, same-site other-port, forged forwarded headers, non-POST/preflight, no secret in metadata/snapshot/errors, bad mode/uid/symlink/oversize/corrupt identity and failure cleanup.

Real browser fake-credential fixture covers default masking, explicit show/hide, successful copy and denied clipboard, late fetch after close, keyboard/narrow/light/dark. Only fake data in screenshots/logs.

Separate explicitly enabled real local installation acceptance: correct source and correct productURL, actual show/copy and connection via existing product form, no model/chat submission or center/runner restart, preserve original usertab/page. Keep real credential entirely in memory; no screenshots/DOM dumps/network traces while exposed, no payload/clipboard logging; retain only boolean outcomes and nonsecretidentity/source.

Deploy only reviewed code using original dashboard operator; restart only dashboard as authorized, retain original browser tab and page. Main/integration and published behavior stay separate from source/fixture approval.

sources.basis: Same-origin includes scheme/host/port; same-site is insufficient and Sec-prefix is browser-controlled.
Same-origin POST normally carries Origin; null/missing is a distinct case requiring explicit policy.
Promise resolves after clipboard update; secure context and NotAllowedError.
Browsers differ; transient user activation may be required.

skills: Existing find-skills, codebase-design, clean-code and webapp-testing reused; no installs. Separate private credential read module behind a narrow Interface; public aggregation stays untouched. No service helper was run.
claimBoundary: Current exact writer conflicts identified by manager: D05 index.html and DPERF04 server.mjs. Must obtain explicit current-version partial scope handoffs before new task take/writes. No arbitrary file-read API or workaround to writer ownership.
